articleTitle: Multi-feature fusion ship target detection based on improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of artificial intelligence, deep learning has also been widely used in the field of computer vision. At the same time, synthetic aperture radar (SAR) has also become a research hotspot in the field of computer vision because of its all-day, all-weather advantages. However, in view of various complex needs in practical engineering, the current target recognition algorithm still has great limitations. In this paper, a method is proposed to enhance the contrast between the target region and the clutter region by fusing various features in the image input, so as to improve the detection performance of ship targets in SAR images. Specifically, this paper realizes multi-feature fusion by placing the SAR image after noise reduction, the original SAR image and the CFAR feature map in the three channels of the RGB image respectively. The test results show that when the improved YOLOv5s detector is used to detect the target, the indicators of the multi-feature image after fusion are significantly improved compared with the detection of each channel information alone. Compared with the original SAR image, the detection accuracy rate of multi-feature fusion image is increased by 4.3%, and the recall rate is increased by 5.5%. mAP0.5 increased by 4.5% and mAP.5:.95 increased by 6.5%, which effectively met the application requirements in practical projects.

articleTitle: Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm Enabled Multi-UAV Optimal 3D Deployment in Emergency Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: With the development of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technologies, UAVs have been pervasively deployed as mobile base stations in emergency communications scenarios. However, due to the limited power supply and communication capability, the optimal 3D deployment of UAVs remains a critical problem. To address the related issues, an improved sparrow search algorithm (ISSA) is proposed in this paper for the optimal 3D deployment of multiple UAVs. Specifically, the deployment of multiple UAVs in the emergency communication scenario is formulated as an optimization problem first, where the coverage rate is optimized by considering the limitations of UAVs’ communication and moving capabilities. Subsequently, the ISSA is developed with a chaotic strategy and a Cauchy-Gaussian mutation strategy to solve the problem. Simulations have been conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed ISSA, where the classical swarm intelligence optimization algorithms in the literature are considered as benchmarks. Simulation results reveal that the ISSA outperforms the benchmark algorithms on the convergence rate and coverage rate.

articleTitle: Exploring Jaw Morphology and Patient-specific Dynamic Rotation Trajectory Using Cone Beam Computed Tomography
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) is a widely adopted technology in dental healthcare, particularly for surgical planning. However, effective visualization methods are crucial for formatting and analyzing volumetric data. Two primary formatting options - Curved Multi-planar Reformatting and Direct Volume Rendering - are used widely for evaluating jaw shape and creating panoramic views. Existing software methods frequently require the manual selection of several nodes along the jaw on an axial image that roughly represents the shape of the dental arch. Our work intends to introduce a novel and automatic algorithm for detecting the patient’s jaw from CBCT, suitable for defining a focal trough and evaluating an optimal patient-specific dynamic rotation trajectory applicable to rotational panoramic radiography based only on the CBCT volume data without the need to delineate a dental arch. Our findings showed that this approach works well even for patients without teeth or having heavy metal implants.

articleTitle: The Efficacy of Sunflower (Helianthus annuus) Crop Automated Monitoring System (SCAMS)
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: This study aims to remediate the issue of plant biodiversity undervaluation by proposing an automated irrigation system with increased configuration options for the sunflower crop. Despite being a valuable protein source, sunflower crops’ adaptability to climate change, drought, heat, and soil salinity changes are limited. The proposed solution includes IoT technology for data collection regarding weather, moisture, temperature, and soil fertility. Previous studies have emphasized the importance of managing resources to meet the crop’s demands for optimal output, including good seed-to-soil contact, temperature, and water. The study proposes using a wireless sensor network to monitor and automate agricultural procedures for sunflower crops, which can help farmers save costs and increase output while contributing to plant biodiversity conservation.

articleTitle: The Application of 5G Technology in the Field of Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: With the progress of the times and the rapid development of various industries, especially in the fields of computers and the Internet of Things, the requirements for communication technology as a means of transmitting data information are becoming increasingly high. Especially for mobile communication technology, the speed of improvement from the first to fifth generation mobile communication technology 5G is very fast, so the progress of communication technology can drive the progress of other manufacturing and service industries. With the continuous development of technology, 5G communication technology has gradually become one of the most popular technology fields at present. In these technological applications, the logistics industry is also one of them. In the logistics industry, the application of 5G technology can greatly improve the work efficiency of logistics enterprises, accelerate the operation speed of goods, and further create a more convenient and secure logistics network. This article comprehensively introduces mobile communication technology through in-depth exploration and analysis, analyzes the implementation methods of 5G technology from a technical perspective, and extracts which elements of 5G technology have promoting significance for the new generation logistics field.

articleTitle: A Real-time Tracking Algorithm for Underwater Fish Based on Track by Detection Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Fish tracking under natural waters has a wide range of application values for fish behavior analysis, species observation and water quality condition monitoring. Aiming at the low efficiency and poor real-time performance of current underwater fish tracking algorithms, A real-time marine fish tracking algorithm based on the Track by Detection framework is proposed in this paper. The algorithm improves the Yolov5 detector and Sort tracker, effectively enhancing detection and tracking accuracy while considering both accuracy and speed. Firstly, the CBAM attention mechanism is introduced into the Yolo5 model to better capture key information in the image and improve task accuracy and robustness. In this paper, an optimised version of the SORT algorithm is presented for the real-time tracking of underwater fish, where the Kalman filter has been removed to improve the tracking accuracy and speed. AP and FPS are chosen as the detection evaluation indexes, and MOT challenge standard is used as the tracking evaluation indexes in the Experiments. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved algorithm has increased the tracking accuracy index MOTA by 0.8% compared to the previous version. Additionally, the tracking precision index MOTP has improved by 2.1% compared to the pre-improvement version. The tracking speed has also increased to 75.6 FPS, meeting the requirements for real-time tracking.

articleTitle: Common phase error mitigation based on decision directed data subcarriers in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method using decision-directed data subcarriers to estimate and correct common phase error. This method involves two phases: estimating pilot CPE for the current symbol using pilot subcarriers and estimating the previous symbol’s CPE using data subcarriers. To derive the decision directed CPE, LLR values from the previous symbol’s data subcarriers are decoded, modulated, and compared with the previous symbol. And, threshold values specific to each QAM constellation were used to select data subcarriers, preventing CPE distortion from incorrectly detected data. The DD-CPE estimated from selected data subcarriers introduces a one-symbol delay but provides more accurate CPE values compared to pilot CPE due to the increased use of data subcarriers. Simulation results indicate that for HT-MM MCS7 frame, DD-CPE estimation gains 0.59dB compared to pilot CPE estimation but experiences a 0.35dB performance loss compared to the ideal genie CPE estimation.

articleTitle: Design of Pig Farm Environment Regulation and Video Monitoring System Based on Livestock Internet of Things Orbital Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Livestock Internet of Things is the application of Internet of Things (IOT) to the animal husbandry to realize the collection, transmission, and calculation processing of animal husbandry information to achieve smart breeding, promote the development of the breeding industry, and improve breeding efficiency. Pigs are an important component and pillar industry of the livestock breeding industry [1]. Temperature, humidity, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, NH3, H2S and other malodorous gases in the pig house seriously affect the health of pigs [2]. Current pig house environmental regulation is based on fixed-point sensor data collection and cannot collect environmental information of the entire pig house. In order to avoid the spread of diseases caused by contact with the outside, the farms adopt closed management. Farm owners, investors and other stakeholders can only view the internal situation by installing fixed cameras. This method can only view the situation of the pig house from a distance. And there are blind spots in video surveillance. In order to achieve uniform regulation of the pig house environment and mobile video monitoring to achieve “cloud farming”, this article designs a track inspection robot based on the livestock Internet of Things to achieve uniform regulation of environmental information and mobile video monitoring in the pig farm. It aims to use the Internet of Things and sensors, robots, image processing and other technologies realize uniform control of the pig house environment and unmanned breeding, save breeding costs, improve breeding efficiency, and promote the development of smart animal husbandry.

articleTitle: Region Proposal Networks (RPN) Enhanced Slicing for Improved Multi-Scale Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Detecting objects in high-resolution images, particularly those from advanced drones and satellites, presents significant challenges to traditional object detection methods. These challenges are amplified when dealing with multi-scale objects, ranging from very small to larger sizes. Traditional slicing-aided methods like SAHI have shown proficiency in enhancing the detection of smaller objects but often struggle with larger object detection due to the limitations of fixed-step sliding windows. In this work, we introduce the Enhanced Slicing-Aided Inference Framework (ESAHI), a novel approach that integrates Region Proposal Networks (RPN) into the slicing process. This integration effectively overcomes the constraints of fixed-step slicing, thereby improving the detection accuracy across multiple object scales. ESAHI utilizes RPN to generate object-centric regions in high-resolution images, creating additional patches that retain complete features of larger objects. These patches are processed alongside those obtained through traditional sliding windows, ensuring comprehensive coverage of the imagery. Our comprehensive evaluations on the VisDrone2019 dataset demonstrate that ESAHI significantly enhances object detection performance. Specifically, ESAHI increases object detection average precision (AP50) for medium-sized objects by 1.5%, 1.6%, and 4.7%, and for larger objects by 7.3%, 8.2%, and 22.3% across different slicing sizes of 640*640, 480*480, and 320*320, respectively.

articleTitle: LoRaWAN for Underwater System: Early Results from Performance Testing on the Swimming Pool
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: This paper presents the experimental results of testing the performance of LoRaWAN operated underwater. The parameters that were tested are RSSI and SNR. The data collection testing was done in a ground environment and a swimming pool. The experiment was divided into 4 (four) scenarios determined by the placement of the LoRaWAN gateway and sensor nodes and the SF (spreading factor) settings, which are AW2UW (Above water to Underwater) with 4 meters distance, AW2UW (Above water to Underwater) with a distance of 8 meters, UW2UW (Underwater to Underwater) with a distance of 4 meters, and UW2UW (Underwater to Underwater) with a distance of 8 meters. The experimental results demonstrate that the choice of SF and the distance between LoRa modules substantially impact the SNR and RSSI levels; this result helps when selecting technology for some use cases, especially those requiring low power and wide coverage.

articleTitle: Overview and Performance Analysis of Various Waveforms in High Mobility Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: In the high-mobility scenarios of next-generation wireless communication systems (beyond 5G/6G), the performance of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) deteriorates drastically due to the loss of orthogonality between the subcarriers caused by large Doppler frequency shifts. Various emerging waveforms have been proposed for fast time-varying channels with excellent performance. In this paper, we classify these waveforms from the perspective of their modulation domain and establish a unified framework to provide a comprehensive system structure comparison. Then we analyze their bit error rate (BER) performance in doubly selective channels. Based on the discussions on their complexity and compatibility with OFDM systems, we finally give some candidate waveform suggestions.

articleTitle: Conservative Periodic Reallocation Framework: Deciding research resources for research projects based on network DEA
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: Research resource allocation is a significant undertaking for scientific research project management. The data envelopment analysis (DEA) method offers central decision-makers a novel performance-based solution for resource allocation problems. This paper introduces a network DEA-based approach, utilizing the temporal relation to reallocate the total inputs among all decision-making units (DMUs). Specifically, We employ an adaptive framework for iteratively solving the lower bounds of input resource changes and present a centralized allocation strategy that comprehensively considers the capabilities of all DMUs. Finally, we apply this framework on two-period research projects sponsored by a public fund in B city to get a reallocation plan.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent control technology of chicken house environment in large-scale chicken farms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the influence of dust particles and toxic gases on the growth of chickens in chicken houses faced by large-scale chicken farms, this study aims to develop an intelligent control system for chicken house environment in chicken farms, and to explore the solution of intelligent control of chicken house environment by utilizing the Internet, the Internet of Things (IoT), and high-voltage electrostatic and plasma technologies.This study uses a function-driven development approach, using basic hardware such as sensor fusion hardware, communication equipment, high-voltage electrostatic precipitator, and plasma discharge device, and completes the system function development using the ROS (Robot Operating System) embedded development platform and the Java language to determine the usability and reliability of the system by running tests in chicken farms.The core functions of the system include environmental de-dusting and purification by adjusting the strong discharge field, and deodorization and disinfection purification by the plasma reactor. The high-voltage electrostatic discharge technology designed in this study can realize the automatic adjustment function, and the discharge docking area and discharge gap can be changed by rotating the button, so as to change the discharge field strength and achieve different purification design requirements. The plasma reactor adopts a honeycomb structure, the blocking medium is enameled, in order to ensure uniform discharge, the conductive layer is plated onto the enamel plate, the other side of the electrode is made of planed 316 stainless steel plate, the high-speed phase-locked loop MM74HC4046 is used to lock the operating frequency, and the power is automatically adjusted using the PFM method, and the resonant capacitor adopts the new type of capacitor that has a large capacity and a small ESR of the equivalent series resistance. Through the actual operation test in the chicken farm, users are satisfied with the usability, ease of use and reliability of the system and equipment.In this study, an intelligent control system for chicken house environment was designed to create a comfortable and good developmental environment for chickens, to effectively improve the level of intelligent farming, and to provide sufficient experimental basis and theoretical support for the environmental management and optimization of chicken houses.

articleTitle: A Fog Based Privacy Preserving Data Aggregation Method for Vehicular Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of Vehicular Internet of Things (VIoT) technologies, vehicles can now collect and generate large amounts of data. For various applications of vehicular data, it is crucial to aggregate and process it efficiently in condition of privacy preservation. A Fog based Privacy Preserving Data Aggregation Method (FPPDAM) is proposed for traffic congestion prediction in the paper. The proposed method firstly adopts the Douglas-Peucker algorithm to compress the trajectories of vehicles and then uses k-RR (Random Response) mechanism to perturb the sensing data before uploading to the fog nodes. Finally, a Naive Bayes based classification algorithm is designed for regional traffic congestion prediction at fog level. Experimental results on the real dataset validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Random Forest Stratified K-Fold Cross Validation on SYN DoS Attack SD-IoV
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Communication Engineering and Technology (ICCET)
abstract: In response to the prevalent concern of TCP SYN flood attacks within the context of Software-Defined Internet of Vehicles (SD-IoV), this study addresses the significant challenge of network security in rapidly evolving vehicular communication systems. This research focuses on optimizing a Random Forest Classifier model to achieve maximum accuracy and minimal detection time, thereby enhancing vehicular network security. The methodology involves preprocessing a dataset containing SYN attack instances, employing feature scaling and label encoding techniques, and applying Stratified K-Fold cross-validation to target key metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. This research achieved an average value of 0.999998 for all metrics with a SYN DoS attack detection time of 0.24 seconds. Results show that the fine-tuned Random Forest model, configured with 20 estimators and a depth of 10, effectively differentiates between normal and malicious traffic with high accuracy and minimal detection time, which is crucial for SD-IoV networks. This approach marks a significant advancement and introduces a state-of-the-art algorithm in detecting SYN flood attacks, combining high accuracy with minimal detection time. It contributes to vehicular network security by providing a robust solution against TCP SYN flood attacks while maintaining network efficiency and reliability.
